mapping_json.fidelity_notes: chain + shadow(chaos) is the base geometry/element and lands; drain for the life-sacrifice register (poison is the alt chaos-DoT read, but the DOMINANT loop is a hit-nova that DRAINS minion life, not a stacking DoT — §7.2 dominant-loop wins). THE IDENTITY MISS: minions-as-CONSUMABLE-BATTERIES. Dark Pact's soul is an INVERSION of the normal proxy pattern — you don't direct skeletons to attack; you CONSUME their max-life as ammunition (Minion Life supports scale YOUR damage BY raising the battery capacity). The engine PROXY family + resource_economy models proxies that ATTACK and are sustained; it has no lane for 'proxy max-life is a consumable ammo pool the caster spends per cast.' Mapped as chain-nova + a totem-proxy field + minion-life-consume note + hp_cost_scale for the no-skeleton self-cost fallback (native), which captures the chain-chaos-nova + self-cost feel but LOSES the minion-as-battery consumption substrate. A Dark Pact player would notice their skeletons no longer FUNCTION as a spendable life-pool that Minion-Life gear inflates — the battery inversion is what made this kit unique. Docket candidate filed (proxy-max-life-as-consumable-ammo, shared family with animate-weapon batch-01 + bladefall-bladeblast field-resource-consume this batch). Engine chain DECAYS 0.7x/hop (arc-audit precedent): acceptable here since Dark Pact's chain PROPAGATES the sacrifice-nova rather than growing per-hop — but hop-count is capped at engine default (primary+3) vs PoE scaling to more skeletons; noted. PROXY_FISSION (one action -> many proxy interactions) + SACRIFICE_ASCENDANCY (life-as-fuel) are the closest capstones.

payload.geometry: Chain-hop delivery: chaos nova originates at skeleton position, chains to nearby skeletons. Each chain hop generates a new nova at the next skeleton. Coverage scales with number of skeletons and their distribution across the battlefield. When cast without skeletons: nova originates at player's own position (self-damage mode). Area of effect at each hop is small blast radius.

skill_geometry.anchor_quote: The 6% removed life is added to the base damage so the skill does scale with minion life. The skill chains between skeletons when at least three are present, enabling area-of-effect coverage across enemy packs.

payload.loop: Use Spell Totem or self-cast Summon Skeletons to populate the field with skeleton minions. Cast Dark Pact on clustered skeletons — the spell chains between them, sacrificing skeleton life to deal chaos damage in chaining novas. Skeletons die rapidly, requiring constant resummoning (two-button rotation). When no skeletons are present, Dark Pact damages the player's own life instead. Minion Life support gems on skeletons increase their life pool to amplify Dark Pact damage.
